title: European leader confides about UFOs on a park walk

tellings.quote: walked in the park for a while and he was telling me something very interesting about these things.

plain: A former president of a Russian republic, Kiran Ilum Xenov, who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that sometime in the late 1990s the leader of an unnamed European country took a walk with him in a park. According to Xenov, the leader told him something very interesting about UFOs, which would mean that other heads of state know more than they say.
